final: WITH counts AS (SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(track_count) AS average_count FROM counts) SELECT PlaylistId, track_count, track_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(average_count, 0) AS ratio FROM counts CROSS JOIN avg_count ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
